{
  "dataset_name": "electricity",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "nsw_price_demand_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, capturing price pressure relative to load.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Trees can split on price-per-unit-demand, a strong indicator of supply tightness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswprice / (nswdemand + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vic_price_demand_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of VIC price to VIC demand, indicating Victoria market tightness.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 100.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides region-specific supply/demand stress signal for tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "vicprice / (vicdemand + 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "nsw_vic_price_spread",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between NSW and VIC normalized prices indicating cross-region arbitrage.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "spread",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Price spread sign and magnitude drive transfer flows and directional moves.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswprice - vicprice"
    },
    {
      "name": "nsw_vic_demand_spread",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between NSW and VIC normalized demand.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "spread",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative load imbalance between regions useful for splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswdemand - vicdemand"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_demand",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of NSW and VIC demand representing aggregate system load.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregate load level is a key threshold variable for price regimes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswdemand + vicdemand"
    },
    {
      "name": "transfer_deviation_from_neutral",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of transfer from its neutral midpoint of 0.5.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.5],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "High deviation indicates strong directional inter-regional flow useful for splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(transfer - 0.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_peak_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for peak daytime trading periods (roughly 9am-9pm in normalized period).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Peak hours have systematically different price dynamics; clean binary split.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((period >= 0.375) & (period <= 0.875), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of period into 6 four-hour blocks of the day.",
      "value_range": [0, 5],
      "feature_family": "ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Discretized time-of-day enables cleaner categorical-style splits in trees.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.floor(period * 6), 0, 5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "nsw_price_high_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator that NSW price exceeds one standard deviation above mean (>0.10).",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "High-price regime flag offers a clean threshold split for trees.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(nswprice > 0.10, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "transfer_demand_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction of transfer level with total system demand.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures whether high transfer occurs under high or low demand, useful nonlinearity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "transfer * (nswdemand + vicdemand)"
    },
    {
      "name": "market_stress_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Composite semantic score combining elevated prices, high demand, and extreme transfer indicating stressed market conditions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "judgment_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes multi-signal stress into a single ordinal feature trees can threshold.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(nswprice > 0.08, 1, 0) + np.where(vicprice > 0.005, 1, 0) + np.where(nswdemand > 0.55, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs(transfer - 0.5) > 0.3, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "demand_regime_bucket",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal judgment bucket categorizing the overall demand regime as low, medium, high, or extreme based on combined NSW and VIC demand.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "judgment_ordinal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a coarse load-regime split point that trees can exploit alongside finer features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((nswdemand + vicdemand) < 0.6, 0, np.where((nswdemand + vicdemand) < 0.9, 1, np.where((nswdemand + vicdemand) < 1.2, 2, 3)))"
    }
  ]
}
